title: Volume 1 Chapter 1: Nail Chip 2
content: “Huh?”

“What, what, what, what! Azuma-kun, do you want to do nails too!? But I’m going first, okay! You have to do my nails first, or I won’t let you!” The same voice I had imagined echoed in my head. Approaching the work desk in a rush was—Sayori Goto, in person. She wasn’t in her uniform; she was wearing some stylish clothes. As expected of a model.
“Wha… why…?”
“Ahaha, this is hilarious! You’re super surprised!”
“Why are you here!?” The door to the garage office had somehow opened. It seemed she had entered without permission. Should I teach her about the concept of trespassing?
“Y’know, it’s been a few days since I asked you for nails, right? Today’s Sunday, right? You’ve got some time, right?”
“…And?”
“I figured you’d be in your garage making plastic models! I searched for garages around here and found this place! This is the third one!”
“What are you doing…?” She was the type to act on a whim—no, she was already acting as soon as she thought of it.
“I seriously got pumped seeing Azuma-kun’s face! I was like, ‘Oh, there he is!’ I was ready to spend the whole day looking for garages!”
“There are ways to ask first and all sorts of things…”
“But I didn’t exchange messages with you!”
“Ah.” I realized that when she said it. I only used the messaging app to contact my parents. The only people I had exchanged contacts with were a handful, including Miyabe.
“I-I see, then…”

“Yeah, yeah! I’ll definitely be asking you for nail stuff from now on, so it’s better to have each other’s contacts! Let’s do this!” We quickly exchanged contact information on our smartphones. I could only research so much about nails on my own, and I hadn’t even asked about the basic things like what colors she wanted. I needed to communicate more closely.

“Azuma-kun… okay, done! So, how about the nails? Think you can do it?” She returned to the main topic. Or rather, Sayori Goto was probably just dying to have her nails done. I honestly didn’t understand where her enthusiasm was coming from—
“Ah, when I tried painting my own nails, it turned out better than I thought.”
“Ahaha, Azuma-kun’s nails are super pink! They really suit you!”
“Don’t tease me.” I wiped off the nail polish with a cotton pad soaked in nail polish remover. The polish came off cleanly, as if I hadn’t painted anything at all.
“Ew, what a waste. Boys should do nails too…”
“Because it gets in the way of making plastic models.”

“Oh, right. You can’t let your nails grow.” In model making, fingertips are crucial. If you apply too much pressure, the parts can get ruined. There are many situations that require delicacy and patience.
“So, I’ve done some research, but… I still don’t really understand why Goto’s nails can’t hold polish.”
“Hmm, hmm.”

“So, could you show me your hands? Ah, um, let me get a chair…” Since I usually worked alone, I hadn’t brought out a spare chair. I hurriedly placed a folding chair from the corner of the room across from the desk. Now, I was facing Goto across the table.
“Alright, thanks!”
“Ah, yeah, thanks…”
“Oh! And you can just call me Sayori! I’m not good with formalities, and it seems like it’d be easier for you too!”
“N-No, I can’t just—” When the distance closed, I instinctively braced myself. Asking a girl to call her by her first name was a high hurdle for an introvert like me.
“Eh, but…?” Sayori Goto looked puzzled.
“You’ve been teasing me nonstop, so wouldn’t it be better? I’d prefer Sayori over calling you ‘you’!”
“Ah—um…” That’s because she was acting in a way that made me want to tease her!
“Okay, then, Sayori… n-nice to meet you…”
“Yeah!”
Thus began my first nail task, which was way too high a hurdle for an introvert like me.
“——” I stared intently at Sayori’s outstretched hand.

Her skin was healthy. On the back of her hand, I could see a slight change in the texture, like a mix of scales and skin. Her fingers were long and slender, so thin they looked like they could break—but she was a dragon-type subhuman, so she probably had more strength than me. I had a feeling about that.
And then, her nails.
They were clearly different from those of ordinary humans. Slightly thick and curved, golden nails. Up close, I could see they reflected light with a dull shine. It was semi-glossy.
I touched the surface of her nails. It was a bit rough, and I felt a prickling pain against my fingertip. I couldn’t tell just by looking, but it seemed there were tiny spikes.
Could these spikes be what repelled the paint?
“Uh, um…” Sayori, still holding out her right hand, said something.
“When you stare at my hand like that in silence or touch it, it feels kinda embarrassing…”
“What are you talking about? I can’t understand if I don’t look!”
“Y-Yeah, but… Azuma-kun, do you always work with such a serious face?”
“Of course.” I checked her nails from various angles.
“Hmm, I see… You’re okay holding a girl’s hand, huh?”
“Eh?” I realized what she meant.

I had been holding Sayori’s hand with both of mine, staring at it from a close distance. What is this? If it weren’t for the pretense of nails, this would be a bad situation! (No, no, it’s necessary work!)
Feeling my cheeks heat up, I was drawn in by Sayori’s slightly flushed face.
“Uh, it’s all for the nails, right? Besides, you asked me to do this.”
“Y-Yeah, but still! It’s not every day someone stares at my hand like this!”
“Don’t worry. I’ve pretty much seen everything.” I released her hand and picked up the bottle of polish.
“Can I try painting it just to see?”
“Ah, yeah, I don’t think it’ll go well, though…” Sayori said, unusually looking down and speaking negatively.
Was it because of her past experiences with nails?

Anyway, I had to figure out the cause before I could address it. I dipped the brush attached to the polish cap and painted Sayori’s middle nail. (The brush angle is forty-five degrees… don’t apply too much paint… middle, right, left in that order…)
Using the knowledge I had found online, I carefully painted Sayori’s nail. (Ah—this isn’t going to work.) The moment I painted it, I immediately understood through the brush that I had failed.
I could feel the unevenness of her nail surface hindering the brush’s movement. There were rough scales on the surface or something like tiny spikes that were almost invisible.
That was what was preventing the formation of the paint layer, making it impossible to create a layer of paint.
“...I see.”
“Ah, I knew it would turn out like this.” Sayori smiled wryly.
She probably had gone through this many times at home, I thought.
After about ten minutes, the abnormality became more pronounced. The paint dried, causing cracks to appear in the layer, and some of the paint began to flake off.
Sayori’s nails, which should have turned into a classy pink if the layer had formed, had become a mess.
“Has it always turned out like this?”
“Yeah, no matter what I paint, it never goes on well. It’s like the makeup just doesn’t stick at all.”
“Makeup… but is it similar?”
“Glue doesn’t work at all either.”
Nail glue? I was puzzled, but before I could ask, Sayori continued.
“The salon people said it’s because of the surface of the nails, so they suggested making it flat.”
“Well, that makes sense.” Sayori must have bought the metal file at the model shop for that reason.
But it hadn’t worked. She had said her nails were too tough.
“Got it, let’s try filing it down.”
“Uh, okay.”
“Don’t make that face; I’m used to surface treatment before painting.”
“Wow, that’s so pro-like!”
“Don’t tease me…” Now that we were going to file, it was time for the file to come out—
Considering everything we had discussed so far, it was highly likely that a regular nail file wouldn’t be effective.
“Hey, do you know what this nail is made of?”
“Made of…? Ah, I’ve heard that dragon horns and nails have a bit of iron mixed in.”
“Iron, huh—” Humans have iron in their blood, but if the nails contain iron, it makes sense why they’re so tough. Then—
It was time for the mountain of tools in the garage to come into play.
“Got it. I’ll use a file meant for plastic models, but is that okay? I’ll be careful not to cause any injuries, at least.”
“Of course, of course♪ Go for it!” Sayori’s eyes sparkled with anticipation.
“Just so you know, even with that face, nothing interesting is going to happen.”
“Really!? Isn’t there some killer technique for making models!?”
“Killer technique… Making models is just a series of boring tasks. There’s nothing flashy about it. Now, let’s get prepared.”

I pulled out the tools from the garage. A rod-shaped metal file for rough shaping. A paper file for surface treatment before painting. A sponge file for finishing. And a diamond-coated metal file that I rarely used. (Since the area I want to file is large… I guess I’ll start with the sponge file?) I anticipated that the sponge wouldn’t be very effective, but it was worth a try.
“Alright, let me know if it hurts.” I gently pressed the sponge file against Sayori’s nail and moved it back and forth.
“Ahaha, that tickles!”
“Hey, don’t move.” I warned Sayori, who was squirming, as I continued to file.
The results appeared quickly. The sponge file wore down, and a large amount of filing dust danced across the desk.
Looking at the sponge file, it was perfectly indented in the shape of Sayori’s nail.
“Looks like the sponge won’t work.”
Then it was time for the metal file. Even though she was a dragon, I had to be careful with the pressure since I was filing with metal. I moved the metal file back and forth.
“...No way.”

The result was the same as before. The unevenness of Sayori’s nails was wearing down the metal file. A small amount of iron dust floated on the desk. What is up with these nails? The part of the metal file that was pressed against her nails was completely smoothed out.
“...Ah, it’s just like when I tried.” Sayori said nonchalantly.
“Hey, how do you usually take care of these nails? They grow, right?”

“I borrow my dad’s big nippers or something. Apparently, dragons have been using that as nail clippers forever. But it’s not cute at all!” Sayori whined about wanting a cute nail clipper. (So, it’s possible to take care of them with tools. Then, I should be able to manage with the tools I have now…!) I picked up the diamond-coated file.
No matter how tough a dragon’s nails are, they can’t be harder than diamond. I just needed it to file down.
“Oh, I’ve never seen that before!”
“With this, I think…” I pressed the file against Sayori’s nail three times and slowly filed it down.
—Sure enough, a small amount of golden filing dust floated on the desk. (It filed down!) If it’s a diamond-coated file, I can file Sayori’s nails!
“It’s working… it’s working!”
“Really!? As expected of Azuma-kun!”
“Don’t move, just wait a moment!” The amount of filing dust was minimal, but it was a step forward that I had finally managed to work on Sayori’s nails.
I continued to file her nails slowly—
—And so, an hour passed.
“Finally… done, huh…” I checked the texture of Sayori’s nails. From the feel of her fingers, her nails seemed to have been smoothed out quite a bit.
“U-Um, Azuma-kun, thank you for your hard work… are you okay?”
“I’ve never filed down one part for this long…”
“It’s not a part! It’s my nail!” I hadn’t expected it to take an hour. And it was only for her middle nail.
“For now, let’s leave the surface treatment like this… let’s try painting again.” I cleaned up the filing dust on the desk with a handheld vacuum and made sure to remove the dust from Sayori’s hand—
I tried painting the pink polish once more, but—
“...No good.”
It was much better than before. The dried polish had fewer cracks and peeling. It was awkward, but it could be called “nail polish.”
However, it was clear that the formation of the paint layer hadn’t gone well. As a result, the color wasn’t vibrant.
Naturally, for a model like Sayori, it wouldn’t be satisfactory.
As proof, Sayori frowned and looked sadly at her nails.
But perhaps noticing my gaze, Sayori suddenly looked up.
“Ah, thank you, Azuma-kun! This is amazing! I couldn’t paint at all before! I’m really grateful for everything you’ve done!”
I could tell she was being considerate.
But I also understood that what Sayori wanted in a manicure was more than this. After all, it didn’t make sense to only do her middle finger.
“...It took an hour just to file one nail… at this rate, it’ll take an insane amount of time to file all of them…”
“Do you think you can manage?”
“…” I had no idea how to tackle Sayori’s nails.
I knew I could do surface treatment with the diamond file. But it took too long, and it was still incomplete.
If I matched the grit of the files and finished more carefully—yet the time issue only deepened.
“It’s impossible. After all, my specialty is plastic models, and I don’t know anything about nails…” I said, scratching my head with a self-deprecating tone.
As soon as I said it, I regretted it. What was I saying after I had taken this on? What would Sayori think if she heard?
“Ah, sorry. That was…”
“No, I think what you said is correct.”
I felt like I had failed.
In the end, a person like me tends to say things that shouldn’t be said in situations like this.
“Indeed, I did ask you for a favor. I only heard that nails and models are similar… But because you tried so hard, I was really, really happy.”
“Wait, hold on. If I think about it, there’s still…”
“No, it’s fine. I don’t want to take up too much of your time, you know?” Sayori kept smiling, as if she didn’t mind.
Quickly removing the cracked polish with nail polish remover, Sayori began to prepare to leave.
“W-Wait…”
“I was told at every salon that it was impossible. I thought maybe Azuma-kun could do it, but I was being selfish.”
